scope: Same Qwen3.5-2B mathematical Graph on native Apple R1, ordinary and greedy K1 MTP; CUDA regression. Not complete MTP/backend/model/quality acceptance.

progress_estimate.basis: Engineering estimate for the complete cross-backend/selected-model MTP work; not a test-pass percentage.

implementation: One cold Backend owns original Context, allocation domains, execution source, file pipeline and external I/O. Recipe/mtp_graph and Graph execution remain shared.
CUDA retains original StorageOwner/device/pinned/Queue route. Apple uses actual native shared resources/FIFO and no common Queue shell.
Raw native constants use the supported explicit borrow form, with both common StorageOwner and its ready field absent. Model/Family retain the actual source leases and Backend lifetime.
Immutable caller-output facts come from each selected child. Actual initial/caller state pools are prepared after all finite roles/shapes, without native candidate shadow buffers.
Generated state/carry/ID/diagnostic outputs retain their actual GraphOutput owners before append take and retired input unbind. All 12/14 page transactions still use whole-Graph success/publication.

The real selected Apple Copy regions now expose their original recording retired gate and clear bindings only after retirement. Recordings remain reusable; no permission or lifetime check is bypassed.
State storage preparation uses local pools/counts and publishes only after all allocations and actual budget accounting succeed. Allocation-failure injection was not run.

Opaque native allocations use an unattributed-aware execution budget; known cache pools are separate. Explicit native --cache-bytes is rejected before loading; auto is not a complete native backing hard cap.
Standalone CMake uses exported route facts for Apple/CUDA and excludes CUDA Queue-blocking probes on Apple. CMake configure/package consumption was not run in this batch.

native.scope: P15, at most 4 outputs, C64, N1/R1, no prefix, commands replay, full trace

cuda.baseline: Retained current-numerics cuBLASLt consumer; identical original inputs and math policy.
cuda.probe_caveat: Probe interfaces compiled before the final local pool-publication change. These 3 diagnostic images were not linked/run; final main.cc itself compiled and ran on CUDA/Apple.

remaining: Account actual native generated-state/shared packed/MLX private backing without fake logical-byte charges or candidate shadow copies; complete strict cache-byte admission.
Native Apple complete multi-session, prefix, reconstruction, catch-up/T1 and retirement combinations beyond this short R1 run.
Vulkan generated-output fixed backing reuse while an old Snapshot retains readers; no weakening existing reuse gates.
Other selected models/quantizations, cross-shape/model quality and full end-to-end MTP performance.
The explicit native cache-byte rejection is source-reviewed, not a separate executed CLI test in this batch.
